description: This is a PHP class called LocalizedDateFormatter that handles formatting of DateTime objects with localization support, including translating day and month names, and caching format conversions.

classes.name: LocalizedDateFormatter
classes.description: A utility class for formatting dates according to locale-specific rules, including translating day and month names.

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Formats a DateTime object into a string based on provided format, applying localization for days and months.

methods.name: getSearchAndReplaceParams
methods.description: Generates search and replace arrays for day and month names based on the format string, utilizing caching.

methods.name: getSearchReplaceTupleForShortDays
methods.description: Prepares search and replace entries for short day names if format includes short day format character.

methods.name: getSearchReplaceTupleForLongDays
methods.description: Prepares search and replace entries for long day names if format includes long day format character.

methods.name: getSearchReplaceTupleForShortMonth
methods.description: Prepares search and replace entries for short month names if format includes short month format character.

methods.name: getSearchReplaceTupleForLongMonth
methods.description: Prepares search and replace entries for long month names if format includes long month format character.
